decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority (before the building(s) is/are occupied/used).

Condition : 4 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for storing of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the premises hereby permitted is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted for uses associated with the bakery shall not be begun until full particulars and details of a scheme to insulate the premises against the transmission of airborne and impact sound has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given.

Condition : 6 - The use shall not be used for the preparation and/or cooking of baked goods until a scheme for control of fumes and odours including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing.

Condition : 7 - The use shall not commence for the preparation and/or cooking of baked goods until a scheme for the ventilation of the premises of an appropriate outlet level, including details of sound attenuation for any necessary plant and the standard or dilution expected has been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 8 - The use of this two storey replacement building as a bakery shall be restricted to use ancillary to the main shop unit at 94 Harlington Road West and shall not be used as a separate commercial unit.

Condition : 9 - The parking spaces shown on the unnumbered drawing received on 4 November 2002 shall be constructed and available for use before first occupation of any part of the development and such spaces shall not be used for any other purposes.

Condition : 10 - The storage area hereby permitted shall be used only for storage ancillary to the retail use of the premises and for no other purpose (including any purpose in Class B8 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 or any order revoking or re-enacting that order).

Condition : 11 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in all the flank walls of the building hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 12 - No industrial nor storage activity shall  take place anywhere outside the building hereby approved without the prior written permission of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 13 - The flat roof area of the building hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Demolition of existing 2 storey detached building and the erection of a two storey detached building for use as a bakery and storage use.
